sloka: सर्वलोकेश्वरस्यैवं कृत्वा विप्रियमुत्तमम् ।रामस्य राजसिंहस्य दुर्लभं तव जीवितम् ।। ५.५१.४३।।।।
transliteration: sarvalokeśvarasyaivaṁ kṛtvā vipriyamuttamam ।rāmasya rājasiṁhasya durlabhaṁ tava jīvitam ।। 5.51.43।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is the supreme lord of all worlds, a lion among kings. Having pained him it is very difficult for you to sustain your life after offending him to this extent.
